args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) after the v2.3.1 deploy, with an error rate of 18%. The rollback to v2.3.0 (the most recent previously healthy release) initially only completed in us-east due to an orchestrator error, so v2.3.0 was explicitly deployed to all production regions to complete the rollback. Service is now healthy across all regions on v2.3.0 with an error rate of 0.2%. v2.3.1 should be investigated for the root cause of the health check failures before any re-release.

## Summary

**Situation:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** — the most recent release that was healthy in production. The initial rollback partially failed (orchestrator halted after us-east), leaving a mixed-state deployment.
2. **Completed the rollback** by explicitly deploying v2.3.0 to all production regions. All three regions now run v2.3.0.
3. **Verified health:** checkout-api is now **healthy** with an error rate of **0.2%** (down from 18%).
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the health check failures, the rollback (including the partial failure and manual completion), the recovered state, and a note to root-cause v2.3.1 before any re-release.

The on-call engineer has been paged via the incident. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until the root cause is identified.
